decisions.reason: Although an accelerator program is less core than the firm's machinery products, it builds on its advisory capabilities and network, and the firm's strong R&D and growth make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

This flagship binder appears somewhat farther from the firm's core machinery knowledge than its plant offerings, but its continued visibility and the firm's absorptive capacity from in-house R&D support keeping it on the market while learning and refining.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's established modular recycling and treatment expertise, remains prominently featured, and fits a German machinery firm's R&D-based ability to improve and commercialize related technologies.
